decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation is only mentioned on the website and its results are still uncertain, but a large established firm has the slack to carry it, and with no clear shortfall against aspiration there is no trigger to drop it after one year.

The thermal inkjet printer has a page of its own, which signals commitment and fit with the core coding and marking portfolio, so management will keep it while performance is evaluated against aspiration levels.
The piezo inkjet printer is prominently presented and complements the firm's printing range, and with slack available and no evidence of underperformance, problemistic search is not triggered.
